name: Tabularia
original_description: Tabularia is a writing studio for books, articles, and scripts, designed to help you manage the complexity of large projects with easy outlining, fast navigation, and custom timelines. Connect it to ChatGPT and you have an editor who can read, recommend, and revise any part of your manuscript. Open a published page and ask ChatGPT to read it aloud; it finds the page itself and highlights each sentence as it speaks. ChatGPT proposes changes in drafts that leave your own text untouched until you merge them, or edits your text directly when you ask, saving a snapshot of your work first. It can also add comments, notes, timeline markers, and images; set up your book's title page, chapters, and styles; and add design touches like drop caps and ornaments.
